text:
If you’ve got tender plants or anything sensitive to cold, take care of it tonight: a Frost Advisory is in effect through 9 Wednesday morning. Sunset at 6:50 looks clear, with the current north-northwest breeze easing tonight and temperatures slipping toward a low around 43. It’ll be a crisp evening for a walk, but dress for the chill after dark.

Wednesday starts sunny and frosty in spots, then stays bright with a high near 67. The north wind will be light, and the lake should be unusually friendly, with waves a foot or less. The air quality is good, too. Plan on a cool start, plenty of sunshine by late morning, and an easy waterfront day, but protect plants and don’t mistake the afternoon warmth for a warm morning.

WCAX METEOROLOGIST (regional station — Burlington relevance only, never their branding): BURLINGTON, Vt. (WCAX) - Happy Tuesday! It was cool again this morning with most places starting off in the 30s to lower 40s. We do have a bit more in terms of morning cloud cover to start the day, but we should lose that and pick up more sunshine by the time we head into this afternoon. Temperatures start to turn a bit warmer, as we head back into the low and mid-60s come this afternoon. Clear skies tonight will set us up for another cool and potentially frosty start to Wednesday. Most of us will see overnight lows that fall into the 30s and lower 40s to start Wednesday.
